verdict.rationale: Braintrust documents scoring outputs with code as well as LLMs and humans. Its SDK supports trace-assertion scorers, and its API, MCP server and CLI let you author and manage scorers. However, the pack has no first-party example of a user-written custom scorer function: the GitHub example only plugs in the prebuilt LevenshteinScorer. Missing for 10: documented custom scorer function signature and return format, a worked example of a user-defined code scorer or metric, custom metric aggregation details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can write custom code-based scorers and metrics for my evaluations
